subtitle: Concerning orcs and their settlement
body:
Article I — Of Friendship and Common Purpose
The Count’s League and the Company of the Thorn reaffirm the friendship already established between them and shall seek to resolve questions of territory and jurisdiction through agreement rather than conflict.
Article II — Of the Claims of the Count’s League
The Company of the Thorn recognizes the claims of the Count’s League within Inner Castanor, the lands of Ebonmarck, and the province of Silvervord.
The Company shall not contest these claims nor knowingly support another power in opposition to them.
Article III — Of the Claims of the Company of the Thorn
The Count’s League recognizes the lands presently held or claimed by the Company of the Thorn within West Castanor, as falling within the Company’s proper sphere of rule and expansion.

Should Lucian or his lawful successor in future claim a royal title over these lands, the Count’s League shall recognize both that title and the realm thereby established.
Article IV — Of Nürced
The Company of the Thorn shall transfer Nürced to the Count’s League upon the ratification of this treaty.
In return, the Count’s League shall pay the Company fifty ducats in each year from 1471 through 1475, for a total payment of two hundred and fifty ducats.
Article V — Of the Agreed Boundary

Neither party shall knowingly settle, conquer, or assist another power in claiming lands recognized herein as falling within the sphere of the other without first seeking consultation.
Article VI — Of Duration and Renunciation
This treaty shall remain in force so long as both parties uphold it in good faith, unless altered by mutual agreement or openly renounced by either party, with cause declared before the other.
